source_refs.note: Topic 6.3.2.4 (PDF 161, printed 158). The hospital example is general knowledge, flagged.

blocks.text: Organizations must make sure their cloud use complies with legal and regulatory requirements on data privacy, security and industry standards, which vary by region and industry. Providers often offer tools to help meet them.

blocks.prompt: Why might a hospital care where its cloud data are stored?
blocks.explanation: Patient-privacy laws may require medical data to be protected and kept in approved places, so the hospital must choose a compliant provider and settings.

items: Compliance: cloud use must follow data-privacy, security and industry rules.
